artworks.title: The Churchgoers
artworks.description: This print depicts two people standing next to each other. The person on the left is facing to the right, towards the other person, with their hands clasped near their waist, holding a long string of beads. They have a slight smile on their face, and the top of their head is partly covered by a hood. They wear a long, flowing garment. The person on the right is facing slightly to the right, but their head is turned over their shoulder towards the left. They are holding a staff in their left hand, and a small cylindrical object in the right. They have a round face with short hair peeking out from under a tall hat, and they wear a long garment with a cloak over their shoulders. Both people wear shoes with pointed toes. A small foxlike animal is seated near the bottom right corner of the print, scratching its ear with one foot. Swirling ribbons are spread around the two people against a dark background.

artworks.title: The Knight and the Lady
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing next to each other. The figure on the left appears to be a man while the figure on the right appears to be a woman. The man is dressed in armor with a long cape and a hat. The woman is wearing a long dress and holds a key and pouch in one hand. The background features swirling ribbon-like elements.

artworks.title: The Dissimilar Couple
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman standing side by side. The man is positioned with his body slightly turned towards the woman, and his head is tilted in her direction. He has distinct facial features, with a serious expression. He wears a cap with a row of buttons, a long tunic belted at the waist, tights, pointed shoes, and holds a sword. The woman stands with her arms crossed, facing the man. Her facial features are soft, and she wears a tall, elaborate headdress with a lattice pattern, a long dress, and voluminous sleeves. The background has a dark, textured backdrop with a swirling ribbon pattern around the figures, and decorative plants with prominent leaves. The artwork is monochromatic with detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Juggler and the Woman
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures, a man and a woman, against a textured background. The woman stands on the left, holding the man's wrist. She wears a cap and a long gown, with a purse and a container at her waist. The man poses with one leg raised and leans back, with long hair and a tunic. He holds ribbons in his hand. Items like a satchel and a belt are near their feet. Intricate ribbons swirl around them, and a jug rests on the ground.

artworks.title: The Angry Wife
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.7 x 11.1 cm (6 9/16 x 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a print showing a woman holding a broom-like object and engaging in a struggle with a man. The woman is on the left, holding the object above her head in one hand and with the other holding the wrist of the man, who is partially kneeling on the left. They both have pale skin and light hair. Above them is a fantastical creature with the body of a snake, wings, human arms, and the face of a beast. A small dog stands near the bottom left corner of the print, looking up at them. Next to it on the ground is what looks like a discarded apron. The ground and dark background are both detailed with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Organ Player and His Wife
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals, both shown from head to toe. The first person, on the left, is sitting on a bench with a pottery pitcher in their hands, positioned as if pouring. The second person, on the right, is seated at a musical instrument resembling a small organ, playing the keys. Both individuals have distinctive facial features with a slightly elongated profile and are wearing long robes along with hats or head coverings. The person on the left wears a tall, pointed hat, while the person on the right wears a softer, round hat. They are inside a room with intricately designed interior elements, including a patterned floor and detailed woodwork. There is a small dog sitting on the floor between them. In the background, a bed is visible through an open doorway. Various objects, like a book, a jug, and other household items, are placed on shelves behind the individuals.

artworks.title: Circular Ornament with Musicians Playing near a Well
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate circular design with two seated figures and ornate floral motifs. There are two figures seated among elaborate architectural structures that resemble old temples or towers with pointed roofs. These figures are surrounded by a complex arrangement of vines and floral patterns that encompass the entire circle. The design is detailed with swirling lines that give a sense of motion and intricacy to the composition. The use of shading and line work adds depth and texture to both the figures and the surrounding motifs, creating a seamless integration between the central figures and the border decorations. The artwork shows exceptional craftsmanship in the detailed portrayal of each element within the circular frame.

artworks.title: Head of an Aged Man
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a man's head and shoulders. He is slightly turned to the right, with a three-quarter view of his face. The man has a long, flowing beard with curls, curly hair, and a large turban. His facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and distinct cheekbones. The background is plain, emphasizing the intricate details of the man's hair, beard, and turban. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The bottom of the image contains ornate, stylized text.

artworks.title: The Death of Lucretia
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 27 x 18.6 cm (10 5/8 x 7 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The illustration shows several figures, with three prominent individuals in the foreground and several others in the background. The main figure is a seated woman holding a sword, with only the upper half of her body visible. Her facial features are delicate, and she has ornate, braided hair. She wears a detailed, patterned dress. To her left stands a woman with similar clothing and a crown, and to the left of the standing woman is another woman with a headscarf. In the background, a group of men in armor is gathered, some wearing helmets and holding weapons, while a man in ornate armor appears to be gesturing. Beside them is a small dog. The background features Gothic architectural elements, with tall castle walls visible outside a window. The illustration suggests a medieval or early Renaissance context, with detailed textures in the print.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms with Tumbling Boy
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master of the Housebook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic design with whimsical figures and intricate scrollwork. The design features a large shield or crest with elaborate patterns. Atop the shield, two exaggerated figures are depicted in a playful scene. One figure holds a staff with an ornamental object at the end. Inside the shield is an upside-down figure with curly hair. The drawing showcases attention to detail, texture, shading, and a playful exploration of form and content within the heraldic tradition.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms with Lion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic coat of arms featuring a lion. The image includes a shield with a rampant lion, a helmet above it with a lion crest, and decorative mantling around them. The drawing is detailed and intricate, with the letters 'I' and 'M' on either side of the shield and the word 'Vorholt' below.

artworks.title: A Gothic Monstrance
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master W with the Key
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, intricately designed chalice or reliquary. The image depicts a highly detailed drawing of a structure with Gothic architectural design. The object stands on a wide base detailed with floral motifs, leading up to a series of columns, arches, and spires at the top. The drawing showcases craftsmanship and possibly religious or ceremonial significance, with symmetrical floral and filigree patterns.

artworks.title: Ornament with the Tree of Jesse
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate design featuring numerous crowned figures and decorative foliage. The image depicts figures arranged amidst swirling vine-like patterns. The figures, all adorned with crowns, appear in various dynamic poses, holding different objects or playing musical instruments. The background is filled with ornate leafy designs. Each figure occupies a distinct compartment formed by the entwined foliage. The entire composition is executed with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with Two Lovers
artworks.description: The image is composed of swirling lines and ornate shapes forming an intricate floral pattern. A seated woman and man are depicted amidst vines and leaves, with cherubic figures and small animals peeking out. The scene resembles a mythical or enchanted forest, reminiscent of a detailed medieval manuscript border.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.description: The image shows a person from head to toe, standing upright. The individual has detailed facial features, a serene expression, and short, curly hair. They wear elaborate, flowing robes with decoration, including a cloak or robe with fastenings. They hold a book in their left hand and a staff in their right hand, topped with a cross-like design. A ribbon-like banner with text flows behind them. The background is plain with horizontal lines suggesting a floor. A circular halo surrounds the figure's head.

artworks.title: Saint Agatha
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. The individual has delicate facial features and long hair flowing past their shoulders. They wear a crown and a halo surrounds their head. The clothing consists of a robe with ornate designs and a draped cloak. The person holds a symbolic object in one hand and gathers their garment with the other hand. The background is plain with simple lines indicating a floor.

artworks.title: Ornament with Flower and Eight Wild Folk
The Circumcision
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image; diameter): 4.2 cm (1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows six people surrounding a table. In the center, a person is passing a baby to another person on the right. A woman with a halo stands to the left with her arms extended towards the baby. Another figure to her left holds a staff and looks at the baby. Above, three more figures observe. The setting is indoors with an abstract backdrop.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.description: The image shows a man crossing a body of water. He is striding, with one leg forward and the other back. He has a beard and wavy hair and appears to be looking up towards a child on his shoulders. The man wears a long garment that billows around him. He holds a staff in one hand. The child has curly hair and a halo-like light around his head, holding a globe-like object. The background includes a church, trees, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a knight battling a dragon. It features an armored knight on a horse raising a sword above his head to strike the dragon below him. The dragon has a snarling expression and is twisted beneath the horse. The horse's mane and tail are swirling, conveying motion, while the dragon's scales are textured. The background shows hills and grassy terrain, with a smaller figure possibly watching from afar. The monochromatic drawing emphasizes line work and shading to depict depth and tension in the scene.

artworks.title: Four Soldiers
artworks.description: This is a print of four people. To the left of center is a person holding a long sword at their side, with a cloak billowing behind them. On the far left, another person seems to lean on a long spear. A person to the right of center has their back to us and holds a large drum, and on the far right another person plays a long, flute-like instrument. All of the people seem to wear doublets with puffed sleeves, tight-fitting breeches, and feathered caps. The two people on the left have beards, while the two on the right are bare-faced, and they all have pale skin. The setting is outdoors, with a hilly landscape in the background and rocky ground beneath the people's feet.

artworks.title: Knight and Lady on Horseback
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.6 × 11.1 cm (4 15/16 × 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mounted figure holding a whip in a scenic background of a medieval town. The image features a horse with ornamental tack and a figure in a traditional early European costume. The landscape includes detailed illustrations of architecture resembling castles and small buildings, set among hills and foliage. The line work and cross-hatching enhance the depth and texture in the drawing, capturing a historical ambiance.

artworks.title: The Embrace
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.8 × 11.7 cm (6 1/4 × 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This print depicts the full bodies of two individuals standing together inside a room. They are embracing one another, with one person facing us and the other turned away. The person facing us has distinct facial features including a prominent nose and long, curly hair visible beneath a large hat. The other person’s face is partially hidden, though they also have long hair covered by a feathered hat. Both people are wearing long garments with wide sleeves and a flowing design. A sword or long object is seen beside one individual, hanging down towards the floor. Inside the room, there is paneling along the walls and a ceiling with wooden beams. A window with a view of a distant landscape and structures is visible on the right, above a table or chest with carvings and designs. On the floor is a piece of fabric, and a framed item or document is propped against the wall by the bottom-right corner. A painting or framed picture hangs on the wall beside a door on the left. A suspended object is seen hanging from the ceiling.

artworks.title: The Ball
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with a detailed interior setting and several elegantly dressed figures engaged in various activities. The composition showcases a richly decorated room with intricately designed furniture, including a prominent central table with figures seated around it. The architectural layout is elaborate, featuring high ceilings, arched windows, and a balustrade on the upper level. The floor is tiled in a distinct pattern. The artwork captures a moment of affluence and culture from a past era.
